lines.zh: 我横着挪，八条腿挨着海床。
lines.en: I shift sideways, eight legs hugging the seabed.

lines.zh: 毛茸茸的钳子拖过沙子。
lines.en: My fuzzy claws drag across the sand.
Down in the trench it is cold and I crawl slow.

lines.zh: 我一步一停，找热水的味儿。
lines.en: I stop at every step to sniff for vent heat.
My legs are thin, so hurrying makes me slip.

lines.zh: 我爬过热液口，水是暖的。
lines.en: I crawl past a vent where the water is warm.

lines.zh: 冰封海沟里，我沿着裂缝走。
lines.en: In the frozen trench I follow the cracks.

lines.zh: 一只钳子举起，像举着雪。
lines.en: One claw lifts as if holding snow.
The rock is slick, so I crawl on my side.
I go around the crack that bubbles.

lines.zh: 沙里埋着壳，我踩着过去。
lines.en: Shells are buried in the sand; I step over.

lines.zh: 冷得壳发白，我还是在走。
lines.en: The cold pales my shell; I keep walking.
The rubble on the floor jabs my legs.

lines.zh: 我慢慢挪去另一处热泉。
lines.en: I work my way toward another vent.

lines.zh: 我朝着冒烟的方向挪，那里暖。
lines.en: I shuffle toward the steaming vent. Warm there.

lines.zh: 钳子夹着一小块贝壳，我拖着走。
lines.en: My claw holds a bit of shell as I drag along.

lines.zh: 热泉的水一涌，我被推得偏了一步。
lines.en: The vent surges, and I get shoved off course.

lines.zh: 我贴着火山的黑石爬，那里不生苔。
lines.en: I crawl on the black stone. Nothing grows there.

lines.zh: 我蹲在石头上，钳子收着。
lines.en: I squat on a rock with my claws folded.

lines.zh: 毛上沾的细菌，是我养的。
lines.en: The bacteria in my fur are mine to keep.
Hot water seeps from the crack; I lean in.

lines.zh: 有只小虾靠近，我懒得动。
lines.en: A shrimp comes close and I cannot be bothered.

lines.zh: 三滴血的身子，得省着动。
lines.en: With three points of health I move sparingly.

lines.zh: 我用钳子捋了捋腿上的毛。
lines.en: I comb the fur on my legs with a claw.

lines.zh: 海沟太深，光到不了这里。
lines.en: The trench is too deep for light to reach.
The pressure makes my shell click.
I curl up like a tuft of white fur.
A cold current passes; I grip the stone.
A shell beside me closes up.

lines.zh: 我一动不动，等热泉再暖些。
lines.en: I wait, still, for the vent to warm.

lines.zh: 沙粒落在我背上，我不抖。
lines.en: Sand settles on my back; I do not shake.
An empty shell lies tipped over by my feet.

lines.zh: 你潜到这么深，不怕压吗。
lines.en: You dive this deep; does the pressure not hurt?
I raise a claw only to look at you.

lines.zh: 你的灯太亮，我眼睛发花。
lines.en: Your lamp is too bright and my eyes swim.
You are standing by a vent; it burns.
I am small, but my claws pinch meat.

lines.zh: 你靴底带下来的泥，真多。
lines.en: Your boots bring down a lot of mud.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里探出半个身子。
lines.en: I poke half of myself from the crevice.
Your hand comes near; I back away.

lines.zh: 眼睛在你灯里反了一点光。
lines.en: My eyes catch a little of your light.
Only after you leave do I stretch my legs.
My shell cracked and water seeps in.
You broke half of my shell.
Three points of health will not last long.
I fold into the crack with claws up.

lines.zh: 少了两条腿，我照旧横着走。
lines.en: Two legs short and I still shuffle sideways.
The pain makes me drop my claws.
A tuft of fur is torn off; the cold bites.
The rock knocked my sight white.
My claw came off; do not pick it up.
One more hit and I am in pieces.

lines.zh: 你放下的鱼肉，我闻了闻。
lines.en: I sniff the fish you set down.
I do not chase bait; I wait for it to rot.

lines.zh: 那点味道混进热泉里了。
lines.en: That smell is mixing into the vent water.

lines.zh: 一钳下去，我的爪又松开了。
lines.en: One pinch, then my claw opens again.

lines.zh: 我吃毛上的东西，不吃这个。
lines.en: I eat what grows in my fur, not this.
The bait is too far from my crevice.
The more you wiggle it, the less I trust it.

lines.zh: 我拖着钳子，慢慢挪过去。
lines.en: I drag my claws and inch toward it.
Fine, one bite, and only one.

lines.zh: 味道太淡，不如热泉的硫味。
lines.en: Too bland; the vent's sulfur tastes better.

lines.zh: 你膝盖碰翻了我，壳磕地。
lines.en: Your knee tips me over; my shell hits rock.

lines.zh: 我这么小，你也不看脚下。
lines.en: I am small and you still do not look down.

lines.zh: 被撞得转了半圈，我才站稳。
lines.en: Knocked half around, I finally find my feet.
Move over; I crawl slow and cannot dodge.
Your foot stirs up a cloud of sand.

lines.zh: 我钳住你的靴边想撑住。
lines.en: I clamp your boot edge to steady myself.
One bump and my legs go weak.
Do not push; my shell is thin.
I fold into the crack until you pass.
It is crowded down here and you still shove.

lines.zh: 热泉边上，我们凑成一对。
lines.en: By the vent we come together as a pair.

lines.zh: 我用钳子敲了敲她的壳。
lines.en: I tap her shell with one claw.

lines.zh: 两只一起守着这道裂缝。
lines.en: The two of us guard this crack together.
She crawls faster; I keep up.

lines.zh: 毛挨着毛，我们就静下来。
lines.en: Fur against fur, we both go still.
This vent is warm enough for two crabs.
I put myself between her and the cold.
The eggs must go deep in the crevice.

lines.zh: 我们分食同一片壳上的苔。
lines.en: We share the moss on one shell.
In a cold trench, two are warmer.

lines.zh: 我钳起一块碎壳，掂了掂。
lines.en: I pinch up a shell shard and weigh it.

lines.zh: 你落下的东西砸在我旁边。
lines.en: What you dropped landed right beside me.
This pebble is too small to grip.
I drag it back into the crevice.
Not food, yet I haul it into my crack.
My claw slips and the thing falls.
This thing is harder than crab shell.

lines.zh: 我把它垫在身下，暖一点。
lines.en: I tuck it under me for warmth.

lines.zh: 再来一块，我就搬不动了。
lines.en: Bring one more and I cannot carry it.
I will collect it later; leave it.

lines.zh: 有只小虾贴着我钳子过。
lines.en: A shrimp skates right past my claw.

lines.zh: 石缝里有东西在动，我看见了。
lines.en: Something moves in the crack; I see it.
That little fish swims far too close.

lines.zh: 我钳子张开，等它再近点。
lines.en: I open my claws and wait for it closer.

lines.zh: 它撞上我的毛，跑不掉了。
lines.en: It bumped into my fur; it cannot run.

lines.zh: 热水里飘来血味，我去看看。
lines.en: Blood drifts in the vent water; I go look.

lines.zh: 一只小蟹翻着壳，慢得很。
lines.en: A little crab is on its back, slow.

lines.zh: 我盯住那条晃动的尾巴。
lines.en: I fix on that flicking tail.
This target runs faster than I do.
Pin it first, worry about the rest later.
I sidestep to cut off its retreat.

lines.zh: 它往石缝钻，我钳住缝口。
lines.en: It dives for a crack; I clamp the opening.

lines.zh: 我的毛在水里晃，它没看见。
lines.en: My fur sways in the water; it does not see.
One more step and I can pinch it.
It circles; I do not chase, I wait.
The vent heat masks its smell.
I raise both of my claws.
It tries to cross my back; wrong move.

lines.zh: 沙一动，我就知道它在哪。
lines.en: The sand shifts and I know where it is.
It freezes; I freeze as well.
My claw shuts on its tail.
My pinch is not strong, but it holds.
It struggles twice and gets away.
This pinch is only good for scaring it.
Shell against shell, I butt it once.
I grip the meat and twist half around.
It bites my claw; I do not let go.
Too hard; my claws cannot break it.
The hot water helps; it softens first.
Pinch once and flee, that is my style.

lines.zh: 我从冷海沟的石缝里爬出来。
lines.en: I crawl out of a crack in the cold trench.

lines.zh: 冰封海沟的底上，我出现了。
lines.en: I appear on the floor of the frozen trench.

lines.zh: 热液喷口边，我生了下来。
lines.en: I am born beside a hydrothermal vent.
Two of us in this brood, one of each.

lines.zh: 海沟黑得看不见，我照样睁眼。
lines.en: The trench is pitch dark; I open my eyes anyway.

lines.zh: 热水第一口，我就知道到家了。
lines.en: The first taste of vent water feels like home.

lines.zh: 有人把我放在这片裂谷里。
lines.en: Someone set me down in this rift.
The sand is cold; the rock is colder.

lines.zh: 我在深处睁眼，没人看见。
lines.en: I open my eyes deep down where no one looks.

lines.zh: 一只小蟹，也能占一道裂缝。
lines.en: Even a small crab can claim a crack.
Vent water should not be this hot.

lines.zh: 我从石壁上掉下来，壳朝地。
lines.en: I fall from the wall, shell first.
How is there no water to breathe here?
The blast flips me over three times.
Something punched through my shell.

lines.zh: 一股怪力把我提了起来。
lines.en: A strange force lifts me off the rock.
The bacteria in my fur are all eaten.
Lightning runs through the water into my shell.

lines.zh: 底下什么也没有，只有黑。
lines.en: Nothing below, only black.
